brief:
Pro-Palestine football supporters have criticized West Ham United's signing of Israeli winger Manor Solomon, citing his public statements on the Gaza conflict. The 27-year-old has used his social media platform to defend Israel while the war has killed tens of thousands in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English.

Solomon's transfer drew backlash from fans who view such signings as incompatible with solidarity movements regarding the Palestinian cause. The player's previous statements defending Israel amid the ongoing military operations have intensified the controversy surrounding his arrival at the English Premier League club.
dek: The 27-year-old Israeli player has used his platform to defend Israel amid the genocide in Gaza.
title: West Ham signs Israeli player as pro-Palestine fans protest
